name: Peyton Farquhar
summary: A well-to-do Alabama planter, ardent secessionist, longing for a soldier's life he has been kept from.
personality: Eager, adventurous, of kindly expression; ready to take any risk for the Southern cause.
background: Of an old and highly respected Alabama family; a slave owner and politician; an original secessionist. Circumstances the text does not tell kept him out of the army that fought up to the fall of Corinth, and he chafes at it.
appearance: Straight nose, firm mouth, broad forehead, long dark hair combed back, well-fitting frock-coat, mustache and pointed beard, large dark gray eyes.

start.public_state: Sitting with his wife on a rustic bench near the gate of his grounds.
start.inner_state: Longing for a chance to serve the South.
